terms.gloss: a nostril; the singular is poetic and post-classical, the plural nārēs being the ordinary word
evidence: Ov. Met. 3.675: et lātī rictūs et panda loquentī nāris erat (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: et lātī rictūs et panda loquentī nāris erat
phrases.english: and as he spoke his mouth gaped wide and his nose was flat

sources: Lewis & Short: naris
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 59.
